_comment: Single-chokepoint topology. Every agent's MCP client points at ONE governance gateway (src/governance_gateway/server.py, default :3000), which enforces agent-integrity + KKI tool-governance on every call and records both audit chains. Select it with MCP_CONFIG=mcp_config.gateway.json (the loader honors that env var). This replaces the per-agent stock servers; there is no other route to a tool, so governance is non-bypassable by topology — including the free-form `command` (terminal) surface.
